g.text: Figure 2 · Ring organization and local response
Continued review sheet 1 of 2 · supported chemical rings
A An actual matched native interval and ring
All 13 C = 2L pairs: ring width/amount ≈ 2×; peak/matched gain ≈ 1×; recovery agrees within 1.02%.
Independent native meshes/states. Matched gain: endpoint support 3 ↔ full ring support 6; challenges below use full support 3.
B Initial challenged-site gain / own C30 antipodal gain
One 0–3 scale: initial gain varies by <0.09% across placements at fixed C.
Numbers link to sustained responses on sheet 2. Rows are discrete sampled circumferences.
C Common active-loss response at t = 10 / the same size's basal response
Same original core/damage direction; native τ = 0.1778 (WP/Holmes), 0.005623 (Goryachev). Positive conditional F coexists with actual loss in every sham core.
867 planned cells: 652 complete; × = 198 cue/core overlaps; dark gray = 17 unavailable Holmes C80 basals. Native input/time units are not cross-calibrated.
